'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 James Barnes DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[James Barnes]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Set Your Course For Alderaan]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
